answer: Sybil resistance derives from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: honest service must be sustained across many epochs, while stale endorsements rapidly lose weight. Freshly spawned sybil identities therefore have near-zero eigenvector centrality in the EigenTrust matrix, receive little reciprocity-weighted transitivity, and cannot influence or pass consensus. Even basalt, willow, and velvet aliases remain inert until independently trusted.
